findings.summary: Trusted validate has identity controls, but admit negatives and rehashed law-source identity are not dynamically covered.
findings.fix: Route stale package/ref/component/axis/endpoint and correctly rehashed law-source mutations through public n06_h0a_admit_present and assert typed fail_closed.

findings.summary: Scale/efficiency and joins are checked, but four-role expected sign/direction semantics and isolated unit negatives are not established; closure equation remains opaque text.
findings.fix: Define expected sign/direction for all four roles, parse or structure closure semantics, and add isolated public negatives for role and unit mutations.

findings.summary: G2 payload joins/hashes and law payload hashes are recomputed, but public trusted negative coverage is missing and source provenance is self-authorized.
findings.fix: Send G2 and calibration/closure/law payload mutations through public validate/admit and require an authorized source registry/ref before any source-backed positive.

findings.summary: Public catches return typed envelopes, but upstream ArgumentError mapping is message-prefix based and only private translator tests cover the taxonomy.
findings.fix: Use typed upstream status/error adapters and force known gap, conflict, and unexpected exceptions through public validate/admit with no raw escape.

findings.summary: Pending mutation is classified foreign, while the foreign integration fixture is rejected before E0/H0-A binding.
findings.fix: Make pending preserve exact candidate refs plus a typed external gap; separate upstream structural rejection from a public H0-A foreign-target control using a valid typed package/E0.
